candidates.title: Anthropic's new API version removes sampling controls and changes SDK authentication
candidates.summary: Anthropic released Claude API version 2026-10-21 and new major SDK and CLI versions that use it by default.
candidates.what_changed: The new API version rejects Messages requests that include temperature, top_p, or top_k, tightens accepted content-block placement, renames several Admin and Analytics response fields, and ships with major SDK changes including bearer-token authentication and removal of legacy client surfaces.
candidates.why_it_matters: A routine major SDK upgrade can change the API version sent by an application and therefore activate request-breaking behavior, proxy authentication changes, type changes, and removed helpers at once.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Audit request construction, proxy credential handling, tool-runner compaction, message typing, Admin API field parsing, and legacy Completions use before upgrading; test the new API version and the SDK major together.

evidence.rationale: Anthropic's dated release notes and migration guide enumerate the API version, first compatible SDK majors, rejected request fields, renamed response fields, and client changes.
evidence.independent_validation: No independent integration test is claimed; the story reports the vendor's published compatibility contract.
evidence.claim_scope: The story covers documented interface and migration changes. It does not claim performance, reliability, or security improvements from the upgrade.

signal.rationale: The new major SDKs change the API version automatically and combine wire-level breaking changes with authentication, typing, tool-runner, and legacy-surface changes.

learning_gap.existing_explainer_status: The migration guide is sufficiently concrete for a focused briefing; no separate concept explainer is required.

deduplication.candidate_key: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21|Claude API version 2026-10-21|breaking API SDK and CLI migration
deduplication.canonical_event: Anthropic releases Claude API version 2026-10-21 and corresponding major SDK and CLI versions.
deduplication.material_delta: No prior Pulse story covers this API version or its migration contract.

editorial_opportunities.title: Test an AI SDK major as a protocol migration
editorial_opportunities.reason: The release shows why SDK-major upgrades need contract tests for API headers, proxy credentials, request fields, response parsing, and agent-loop helpers rather than only dependency compilation.
